data:
@CategoryTheory.IsFinitelyPresentable.{u_1, u_2,
    u_3} : {C : Type u_3} → [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_3} C] → C → Prop

@CategoryTheory.isFinitelyPresentable_iff_preservesFilteredColimits.{u_1,
    u_2} : ∀ {C : Type u_2} [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] {X : C},
  Iff (@CategoryTheory.IsFinitelyPresentable.{u_1, u_1, u_2} C inst X)
    (@CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFilteredColimits.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_1 + 1} C inst (Type u_1)
      CategoryTheory.types.{u_1}
      (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_1, max u_2 u_1, u_2, max u_2 (u_1 + 1)} (Opposite.{u_2 + 1} C)
        (@CategoryTheory.Category.opposite.{u_1, u_2} C inst)
        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_1 + 1} C inst (Type u_1) CategoryTheory.types.{u_1})
        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.category.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_1 + 1} C inst (Type u_1) CategoryTheory.types.{u_1})
        (@CategoryTheory.coyoneda.{u_1, u_2} C inst) (@Opposite.op.{u_2 + 1} C X)))
